potions.name: Mana Potion
potions.description: Restores magical energy for casting spells.

potions.name: Health Potion
potions.description: Heals the drinker and restores vitality.

potions.name: Rejuvenation Brew
potions.description: Simultaneously restores health and mana.

potions.name: Love Draught
potions.description: Stirs warm feelings and deep affection.

potions.name: Antidote Elixir
potions.description: Cures poisons and grants temporary resistance.

potions.name: Flame Elixir
potions.description: Grants temporary fire powers to ignite objects or attack.

potions.name: Mist Drop
potions.description: Creates a cloud of mist to obscure the player from enemies.

potions.name: Shadow Syrup
potions.description: Turns the player into a shadow, becoming invisible to enemies.

potions.name: Lightning Tincture
potions.description: Boosts movement speed and reflexes temporarily.

potions.name: Wisdom Serum
potions.description: Enhances magical insight and puzzle-solving abilities.

potions.name: Frost Essence
potions.description: Slows down nearby enemies with a chilling effect.

potions.name: Calming Tonic
potions.description: Soothes nerves and quiets a racing heart.

potions.name: Fever Breaker
potions.description: Cools the blood and breaks the worst fever.

potions.name: Bone Mender
potions.description: Knits broken bones overnight.

potions.name: Sleep Draught
potions.description: A dreamless sleep, deep enough for surgery.

potions.name: Ironskin Elixir
potions.description: Hardens skin against blade and claw.

potions.name: Beastbane Oil
potions.description: Coats a blade so beast wounds won't close.

potions.name: Battle Fervor
potions.description: Fearless strength for one desperate charge.

potions.name: Night Eye Drops
potions.description: See in the dark like a cat.

potions.name: Lockbreaker Acid
potions.description: Eats through iron and warded locks.

potions.name: Silent Step
potions.description: Footsteps make no sound.

potions.name: Featherfall Draught
potions.description: Fall from any height like a leaf.

potions.name: Moonlit Cure
potions.description: Purges beast poison from the blood.

potions.name: The Usurper's Draught
potions.description: Restores lost strength and the vigour of youth. Never let Mandrake take the place of Gravecup, or the draught will turn upon the one who drinks it. Notes: Brewed with the blood of one touched by the Light, it takes their life and power… but in the one who drinks it, the Light will be corrupted.
